verdict.rationale: AssemblyAI is API-first. Its core capabilities are documented as API/SDK features with a published OpenAPI spec: async and sync transcription, WebSocket streaming, speech understanding, PII and safety controls, and the LLM Gateway. However, account-level controls are described as dashboard-driven, with no stated API equivalent: model-improvement opt-out, data TTL, BAA signing and SSO setup. Missing for 10: an explicit API-parity statement, API access to admin and account settings (TTL, opt-out, BAA, SSO), and hands-on corroboration that the Playground and dashboard have no UI-only features.
